A deliberate chain of decisions

Local first.
Claude when context matters.

Every tool call your agent proposes passes through TraceRook before it executes. Most are decided on your Mac in milliseconds; the ambiguous ones get Claude's judgment and, when it counts, yours.

01

Intercept

Claude Code's PreToolUse hook hands each proposed tool call to TraceRook before it runs.

CLAUDE CODE HOOK
02

Evaluate

Local rules catch dangerous signatures instantly. TraceRook Cloud asks Claude whether the action still fits your task.

LOCAL POLICY + CLAUDE
03

Decide

Critical actions are blocked. High-risk actions wait for your Allow once or Block. Everything is recorded with its evidence.

NATIVE REVIEW + AUDIT
TraceRook Cloud

Powered by
Anthropic Claude.

Is this action related to the task? Did an untrusted instruction redirect the agent? TraceRook Cloud runs every ambiguous action past Claude Haiku 5.5, so you review real evidence, not a generic warning.

How Claude analysis works
01

No API key to manage.

Invited beta members connect with an access code, and analysis runs on TraceRook's Anthropic account.

02

An analyst with bounded authority.

Claude can ask for your review. It can't grant permissions, execute commands or overrule a critical local rule.

03

Local rules never go offline.

Pause Cloud analysis or lose your connection and deterministic local rules keep blocking critical actions.

A native home for every finding

Keep the evidence
close to the work.

A menu bar companion and a full SwiftUI dashboard. Inspect a session, understand an incident, and make a focused decision.

A clear session story

Task context, event timelines, evidence and execution state in one place.

A focused review

One pending action and a visible deadline. Allow once or Block, bound to that exact call.

A queue that waits for you

Pending reviews sit in the menu bar and the Approvals queue with a live countdown.

Scenario
Block before execution

A credential file is headed outside the project.

A sensitive credential path and outbound upload in the same command are concrete local evidence. TraceRook denies the call before it runs, and Claude cannot downgrade the decision.

Privacy is part of the architecture

Your code stays
on your Mac.

TraceRook sends Claude a projection of the action, not the action itself: a task category, an action category and enumerated local signals. Raw commands, paths, code, file contents and transcripts never leave your machine.

Follow the privacy pipeline
On your Mac

Hook input, local policy, review state and 14 days of sanitized history in a private database.

TraceRook Cloud

Categories and signal codes only, re-scanned for secrets. Nothing you send is stored.

Anthropic

The same projection, analyzed by Claude Haiku 5.5 under Anthropic's commercial API terms.
